messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_burn EU-west p99 crossed threshold for route /v1/generate — 21m spike, 74% SLO burn, pagerduty incident created (INC2350001).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered INC2350001 — Severity: P1 — Assigned to: oncall-sam.

Sam (oncall): Ack'd. Looking now. Any quick context on a deploy or config change? :eyes:

Nisha (infra): No recent infra deploys in EU-west in the last 30m. Autoscaler events show scale attempts but many pending due to quota.

Anya (support): Getting a couple of customer DMs — low throughput but requests timing out. Customers impacted: two enterprise apps in eu-west staging, one prod account reported errors.

Mike (runtime): Seeing long tail on kv-cache miss rate for long prefixes. p95 ok-ish (~180ms) but p99 is ~1.7s and climbing. There's also an increase in batch sizes, larger seq len. Logs showing retransmits: 
```
2023-11-17T14:05:03Z ERROR serve: request wait 1200ms, backend queue len=42, kv_miss=true
2023-11-17T14:05:04Z WARN  batching: batch size=32 seq=2048
```

Priya (sre): CPU on shard-gpu-07 climbed to 92%, memory ok. Autoscaler reports unable to spin new pods: hitting regional GPU quota. Putting quota request in parallel.

Sam (oncall): Immediate mitigation options? Can we fall back to a lower-cost model or smaller batch policy? We need to reduce tail latency quickly.

Mike (runtime): Two quick mitigations: 1) force per-request batching to max_batch_size=8 for affected route (drops throughput but lowers tail). 2) route eu-west traffic to eu-central read-only cluster which has spare capacity — but that will increase cross-region latency for some customers. I can flip batch config in 2m.

Nisha (infra): I'm authorising temporary burst capacity from shared pool — will take ~4-6m to provision. Quota request may take longer. If Mike flips per-request batching we can buy time.

Sam (oncall): Do it. Mike, apply batch limit change and add a routing policy for canary traffic to eu-central for non-critical tenants. Priya, follow up on GPU quota escalation. Anya, notify impacted customers with ETA ~15m and mitigation steps.

Mike (runtime): Applying config now: 
```
route:/v1/generate {
  max_batch_size: 8
  kv_cache_prefetch: true
}
```
Applied at 2350001139. Rolling update triggered.

incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE recorded by Mike (runtime) at 2350001139.

Sam (oncall): Monitoring metrics. p99 dropped from 1.7s -> 980ms in first 30s after change. Good.

Priya (sre): Autoscaler: added 2 nodes from shared pool at 2350001156, GPU quota escalation submitted to cloud support (ticket CLOUD-67890).

Anya (support): Message sent to affected accounts: "We're seeing elevated tail latency in eu-west; mitigation in progress, expected improvement within 15 minutes. We'll update you shortly." :email:

Nisha (infra): Cross-region routing to eu-central enabled for non-prod tenant set A at 2350001168. Observing slightly higher p50 but p99 improved.

Sam (oncall): p99 now stable ~520-650ms for eu-west aggregate. SLO burn reduced to 12%. I'm going to hand this to Nisha for infra follow-up and Priya for quota/ops. I'll remain available for escalation.

Priya (sre): Taking post-mitigation actions: will track CLOUD-67890, schedule autoscaler tuning, and run a controlled rollback if node provisioning stalls.

Nisha (infra): I'll keep the temporary burst until quota confirmed, and coordinate with runtime to revert batch limits once capacity stable.

Anya (support): Updated customers with mitigation and monitoring link. No critical data loss reported.

Sam (oncall): Closing PagerDuty ack and marking incident as mitigated for now. INC2350001 -> status: mitigated at 2350001198. Will file a short postmortem — assigning to Nisha + Mike for root-cause and long-term fix. :memo: :white_check_mark:
